league:title: League
league:title__note: Screen title for the weekly leaderboard of 30 people. Max 16 characters.
league:tier.bronze__note: League tier name. The seven tiers are Bronze, Silver, Gold, Sapphire, Ruby, Emerald, Diamond. Max 20 characters.
league:tier.silver__note: League tier name. Second of seven. Max 20 characters.
league:tier.gold__note: League tier name. Third of seven. Max 20 characters.
league:tier.sapphire__note: League tier name. Fourth of seven. Max 20 characters.
league:tier.ruby__note: League tier name. Fifth of seven. Max 20 characters.
league:tier.emerald__note: League tier name. Sixth of seven. Max 20 characters.
league:tier.diamond__note: League tier name. Seventh and highest. Max 20 characters.
league:division__note: Under the tier name. {division} is 3, 2 or 1, with 1 the highest. Max 16 characters.
league:toPromotion: {xp, plural, one {# XP to move up} other {# XP to move up}}
league:toPromotion__note: How much XP would put the reader in the promotion zone. This screen NEVER shows how far ahead of relegation they are — see the kindness rules in docs/systems/social-and-leagues.md.
league:inZone: You are in the promotion zone
league:inZone__note: Shown instead of the line above when the reader is already high enough to be promoted. A statement, not a warning to defend it. Max 40 characters.
league:endsIn: {hours, plural, one {# hour left this week} other {# hours left this week}}
league:endsIn__note: Time remaining in the league week. Stated in hours, never counted down in seconds — no pressure.
league:promoteRule: {count, plural, one {The top # moves up} other {The top # move up}}
league:promoteRule__note: States the rule once, as a fact about the week. Deliberately says nothing about who moves down. Max 40 characters.
league:you__note: Shown in place of the reader's own handle in their own row. Max 8 characters.
league:xp__note: The weekly XP on a leaderboard row. Max 12 characters.
league:row.label: {position}. {handle}, {xp} XP
league:row.label__note: Spoken label for one leaderboard row, read as one element. Position, then who, then the score — the order a person would say it.
league:empty.title: No league yet
league:empty.title__note: Shown when the reader is not in a cohort. This is the ordinary state, not an error. Max 24 characters.
league:empty.body: Leagues start on Monday. Keep learning this week and you will be placed in one with 29 other explorers.
league:empty.body__note: Explains rather than apologises. Max 110 characters.
league:error.title: Could not load the league
league:error.title__note: Shown when the standings request failed. Max 30 characters.
league:error.body: Your XP is safe — this is just the leaderboard.
league:error.body__note: Reassures that nothing was lost, which is the thing a user actually fears here. Max 60 characters.
league:settings.label: Leagues
league:settings.label__note: Settings toggle label for the weekly leaderboard. Max 16 characters.
league:settings.help: A weekly leaderboard with 29 other people. Nobody sees your name, and you can leave at any time.
league:settings.help__note: Under the toggle. Says what is shared before asking them to opt in. Max 110 characters.
league:home.chip__note: The rank shown on the Home screen's league chip — just the tier name, e.g. 'Bronze League'. Max 20 characters.
league:home.position__note: The reader's place in their cohort, on the Home chip. Max 14 characters.
league:offline.title: You are offline
league:offline.title__note: Shown on the league screen with no connection and nothing cached. Max 24 characters.
league:offline.body: The leaderboard needs a connection. Your XP is still counting — it will be here when you are back.
league:offline.body__note: Reassures that learning offline still counts toward the week, which is true and is the real worry. Max 110 characters.
league:offline.badge: Offline — these standings may be behind.
league:offline.badge__note: One line above cached standings. Says which numbers these are rather than passing them off as current. Max 50 characters.
